**B1 CLOSED (#254+#255 merged); Track B foundation complete; next B2 = Antigravity adapter + baptism (#247)**

## State 2026-07-12 — Track B foundation COMPLETE
**B0 #252 ✅ + B1 #254 (+ co-promotion #255) ✅ merged** (tracker 565a628). ADR-0019 Accepted in decisions/, sdd-layout.md in brain/core/methodology/, the 6 gates read the accessor with golden proof, 1426/1426. The tripwire guarded the merge order and died green. Track B: the harness port is written as contract, wired onto itself, and proven n=2 on `init` (with the `plain` foundation backend).

## NEXT: B2 — the second REAL inhabitant + the baptism (two halves)
1. **Instruction-emission adapter (port surface 1):** a real Antigravity backend whose `init()` emits/installs the instruction file Antigravity reads. Designed against REAL Antigravity — the explore is EMPIRICAL (human as operator, product in hand, NEVER from memory — the recorder/[[env-limits-not-world-properties]] lesson): which instruction file + precedence; does it run real shell (npm test/git/gh) from its loop; how its native memory subordinates to / coexists with .memory/ (doctrine: team memory = brain's .memory/, harness memory = personal cache). Empirical questions needing the harness open go to the human IN A BATCH, not one-at-a-time.
2. **The baptism:** Antigravity completes **#247** (chunk migration — real, bounded, 3 concrete consumers, all gates watching) as a governed slice end-to-end, human as operator. **B2 acceptance = #247 merged, done through Antigravity, with ZERO gate modifications** (DoD §11.2/§11.4 — the port proven by a second real inhabitant, not a strawman).

Non-goal: B3 (no speculative n=3); changing any gate to accommodate Antigravity (would invert the proof). Circuit: draft → status:approved → SDD → CP-B2. #247 needs its own status:approved for the baptism.

Open external keys still: SCIT mirror endpoint (A-track bundle). See [[sdd/issue-253-b1/constraints]], [[memory/orphaned-chunks-post-c4]] (#247).
